summary: Frontend-only validation of iteration 227 (Miracurl Suite pricing redesign + mobile tile carousel + new /features page). All critical flows pass: two-door pricing cards, region toggle (INR/USD) updates salon + resto plan cards and hero door prices, auto-detection via sessionStorage miracurl_geo_region, mobile carousel scrollWidth > clientWidth with swipe hint and no page-level horizontal overflow, desktop grid behavior, deep-link scrolling to #slug on /features for both salon and restaurant tiles, and header FEATURES link navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Pricing region toggle buttons do not expose aria-pressed state (both return null). Consider adding aria-pressed='true/false' for a11y and clearer selected-state semantics.
Footer uses data-testid='landing-footer' instead of 'footer'. The review request listed 'footer' as the testid; either align the id or document the alias to avoid future test confusion.
Many 401 console errors on load (likely background authed probes). Not blocking but noisy — consider gating those calls behind an auth check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated against GET /api/public/plans: INR monthly=1455, annual=14550, multi-branch from 40000; resto INR monthly=1000; INTL salon tiers starter/pro/premium + enterprise block + resto $45 start. Region toggle flips plan cards, resto cards, enterprise block visibility and hero door-salon-price/door-restaurant-price. Mobile tiles-salon scrollWidth=2448 cw=390, tiles-restaurant 1842/390, swipe hint visible, page scrollWidth==390. Desktop (1280): both tile containers sw==cw (grid). Deep-links: tile-salon-pos-billing-crm → /features#pos-billing-crm (feature in-view top=112px); tile-restaurant-qr-table-ordering → /features#qr-table-ordering (top=230px). features-jump-nav has exactly 14 jump links; features-group-salon=8 rows, features-group-restaurant=6 rows; sample feature-cta-* link resolves region-aware signup route.
